theorems.name: Submission.codim1_rdo_c1a_egorov_isClosed
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (C : Set (Euclid n)) (η : ℕ → Euclid n → ℝ) (g : Euclid n → ℝ), MeasurableSet C → (∀ k, Measurable (η k)) → Measurable g → (∀ x ∈ C, Tendsto (fun k => η k x) atTop (𝓝 (g x))) → ∀ ε : ℝ≥0∞, 0 < ε → ∃ A : Set (Euclid n), A ⊆ C ∧ IsClosed A ∧ volume (C \ A) < ε ∧ ∀ Q : Set (Euclid n), IsCompact Q → Q ⊆ A → TendstoUniformlyOn η g atTop Q
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
